body: A platform for building and deploying AI agent workflows and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.
plain_description: **Build and launch AI-powered workflows and apps from one collaborative workspace.** Create agents and RAG pipelines, then deploy on Dify Cloud or in your own environment.
technical_description: Dify is an open-source LLM app development platform with visual AI workflow building, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, model management, and application monitoring. It integrates with proprietary and open-source models, including OpenAI API-compatible models, and provides APIs for integrating Dify apps into business systems. The README documents Docker Compose self-hosting and hosted Dify Cloud.
title: Dify
